issues.problem: The input bindings provide only a primary click for placement. They provide no '[' and ']' keys or on-screen controls to select a depth layer, so players cannot reliably pick inner cube cells as required by the lift plan.
issues.fix: Add depth-layer selection controls to input_ir and make the click-generated rule_coordinate include the selected z layer.

issues.problem: Placement clicks use a full coordinate, but the input bindings provide no '[' or ']' keys or on-screen depth controls. Players cannot select a depth layer to pick inner cells as required by the lift plan.
issues.fix: Add '[' and ']' depth-selection bindings, or on-screen depth buttons, and make cell picking supply the selected layer in the placement target's (x,y,z) coordinate.
